events.title: Bands in Parks
events.location: Kite Terrace, Thomas Dixon Centre, West End
events.description: An open-air performance showcasing live local music in a relaxed park setting. Part of the recurring city-wide series intended for community engagement.

events.title: Everly Brothers & Friends and Roy Orbison
events.description: A tribute concert celebrating the classic hits and legacy of The Everly Brothers and Roy Orbison. Expect a nostalgic performance centered on mid-century rock and pop arrangements.

events.title: 2026 BLACK PRIDE QUEER NAIDOC
events.description: An evening of music and performance art celebrating Indigenous queer culture and identity. This event combines live music with cultural expression at the Brisbane Powerhouse.

events.title: Larry Fleet
events.description: American country and soul singer-songwriter Larry Fleet performs a live headlining show. Known for his blend of blue-collar storytelling and melodic instrumentation.

events.title: Troy Cassar-Daley
events.description: Acclaimed Australian country music artist Troy Cassar-Daley performs a live show. He brings his extensive catalogue of storytelling and songwriting to the Fortitude Music Hall stage.

events.title: Pierce Brothers - Moonrise Album Tour
events.description: Indie-folk duo Pierce Brothers perform an afternoon set in The Triffid Garden as part of their latest album tour. Expect high-energy folk instrumentation in an intimate outdoor setting.

events.title: St Peters Performer of the Year
events.location: Dron Auditorium, St Peters Lutheran College
events.description: A showcase of student musical talent competing for the Performer of the Year title. The event features diverse musical performances across multiple genres.
